premises.premise: At head b96a362, a Ledger.transfer refused because the source or the target is frozen (or for any other LedgerError) mutates neither account: every raise precedes both appends, and neither append can raise between them.

sources.text: A frozen account accepts no new entries of any kind: postings, transfers out of it, and transfers into it each raise `LedgerError`.
A refused operation changes no account.
A refused operation leaves every account unchanged.
